title: Decree #101: The Container Illusion
quote: Go compiles into a single 10MB static binary that runs anywhere. Python requires 4GB of Docker images, 3 virtualenvs, and prayer.

title: Decree #102: Lifetime of Regret
quote: Rustaceans spend 40 minutes fighting borrow checker lifetimes to print 'Hello World' safely. Gophers shipped to production 39 minutes ago.

title: Decree #103: Mass of the Universe
quote: The heaviest objects in the known universe: 1. Black holes. 2. Neutron stars. 3. A blank React project's node_modules folder.

title: Decree #104: Bureaucracy of Enterprise
quote: Java enterprise architectures require an AbstractSingletonProxyFactoryBean to instantiate a boolean. Go requires `var b bool`. Choose freedom.

title: Decree #105: The Divine Repetition
quote: Unenlightened developers complain about 'if err != nil'. Enlightened gophers know it is a meditative mantra reminding us that all human creation is flawed.

title: Decree #106: The Global Lock of Shame
quote: Python developers celebrate removing the GIL in 2026. Go has been running millions of goroutines across all CPU cores without breaking a sweat since 2009.

title: Decree #107: The Supply Chain Tragedy
quote: A modern JavaScript web app imports 847 packages just to check if an integer is odd. Go uses `n%2 != 0`. The Ministry mourns npm users.

title: Decree #108: Scroll of Arcane Errors
quote: A C++ compilation error spans 4,000 lines of template spew because you passed `int` instead of `size_t`. Go compiler tells you in 12 characters and finishes compiling in 80ms.

title: Decree #109: Manual Memory Delusion
quote: You believe you are smart enough to manage manual memory without leaks or use-after-free vulnerabilities. The Ministry and your segfaults disagree.

title: Decree #110: Type Coercion Catastrophe
quote: In JavaScript: `[] + [] = ""`, `[] + {} = [object Object]`, and `{} + [] = 0`. In Go: the compiler slaps your keyboard and refuses to run nonsense.

title: Decree #111: The JVM Tribute
quote: Starting a Gradle daemon requires sacrifice of 8GB of RAM and heating your room to 40°C. `go build` runs on a refrigerator display clock.

title: Decree #112: The Stdlib Supremacy
quote: Other languages require third-party frameworks, ORMs, and 45 plugins to listen on port 8080. Go does it in 5 lines of standard library. Zero external dependencies.

title: Decree #113: The Function Color Prison
quote: What color is your function? Is it red? Is it blue? Is it Promise<Promise<void>>? Go laughs: just `go doThing()` and move on with your life.

title: Decree #114: The Infinite Barista
quote: Rust compile times are a government conspiracy sponsored by artisan coffee shops to keep developers away from their keyboards.

title: Decree #115: What Is An Array?
quote: PHP arrays are simultaneously lists, hash maps, queues, stacks, and existential crises. Go slices are a pointer, length, and capacity. Order restored.

title: Decree #116: The Anarchy of Monkey Patching
quote: In Ruby, any gem can redefine `Integer.+` at runtime to subtract instead. Go does not allow you to even have an unused import. Strictness is love.

title: Decree #117: Crime Against Silicon
quote: Packaging an entire Chromium browser to display a desktop calculator is a crime against silicon. Go CLI utilities consume 4MB and run at lightspeed.

title: Decree #118: Merge Conflict Purgatory
quote: There is no human sorrow greater than resolving a 14,000-line package-lock.json git conflict. Go has `go.mod` and `go.sum`. Peace reigns.

title: Decree #119: The Suggestion Box
quote: Python type hints are merely gentle suggestions that the runtime cheerfully ignores while crashing on `AttributeError: NoneType has no attribute 'get'` in production.

title: Decree #120: Final Revelation
quote: The Ministry declares: Go code written in 2012 still compiles and runs without modification today. Your favorite framework was rewritten 4 times this morning.
